full_judgment:
Mr. Syed Md. Ziaul Karim, J.:- This Rule, at the instance of defendant petitioner calls in question the legality and propriety of judgment and order dated 10-06-2009 passed by learned District Judge, Lakshmipur, rejecting Misc. case no.05 of 2009 filed under section 24 C.P.C for withdrawal of Title Suit no.202 of 2007 pending in the court of Senior Assistant Judge, Lakshmipur and transferring it to the first court of joint District judge, Lakshmipur for simultaneous trial with Title Suit no.31 of 2008. 

 4. Then the petitioner who is defendant of both suits sought to transfer the former suit for simultaneous trial with the later in Misc. case no. 05 of 2009 under section 24 C.P.C which was rejected by the impugned order. Hence the Rule. 

 9. On going to materials on record it spires that nature of both the suits are identical. The conflict arose between plaintiff and defendant who are mother and sons respectively over execution of heba deeds. The petitioner is defendant in both the suits and opposite party no. 1 is the plaintiff. It further transpires that conflict erupted between mother and son over self same plots, only difference is the quantum of land. So, in my view to avoid conflicting decision both the suits should be tried simultaneously. With that end in view, suits of this nature may be transferred. Evidence should be taken separately and each suit should be disposed of by separate judgment by the same court. Therefore the court below without appreciating such material facts by rejecting Misc. case for transfer committed an error of law. 

 10. Moreover, the impugned order in its entirety is not well founded in the facts and circumstances of the case. So, the grounds urged and contentions advanced by learned Counsel for petitioner prevails and appears to have a good deal of force. 

 12. In the result, the Rule is made absolute. The impugned order dated 10.06.2009 passed in Misc. Case no.05 of 2009 is hereby set aside. The learned District judge, Lakshmipur is directed to withdraw Title Suit no.202 of 2007 from the court of Senior Assistant Judge, Lakshmipur and transfer it to the first court of Joint District Judge, Lakshmipur for simultaneous trial with Title Suit no.31 of 2008. The order of stay granted earlier stands vacated.
